Minor update

notes.title: Patch 1.10
notes.content:
Hi Retro Rugby Fans

New patch notes:
1) Added actual referees on the pitch. Along with touch judges.
2) They will raise their flags on successful conversion or goal kicks.
3) Tackling success rate has been increased across the board. There was a small bug in the calc
4) Passing glitch fixed Sometimes ball will drop to floor, then only moments later gets passed.
5) Flyhalves now more dynamically choose positioning during rucks
6) Second half HUD text now actually states its the 2nd half..lol

Enjoy.

Regards

notes.title: Patch V1.09a
notes.content:
Hi Retro Rugby Fans

Small update:

1) Fixed issue where kick gets interrupted after scrum
2) Fixed issue where 0 player are shown in the career squad menu
3) Fixed error where wrong player info is shown at bottom of career team sheet on selected player
4) Fixed error when your players runs back for a ball kicked behind them, they sometimes will stop chasing the ball
5) Might have fixed error where cpu team passes ball through receiving players

Career changes might not work on old saved careers. On a new fresh career, the fixes will be applied.

Enjoy

notes.title: Patch 1.09 Lions25
notes.content:
Hi Retro Rugby Fans

1) Added a new team to unlock
2) Attacking runs from rucks are now deeper. This helps to generate more momentum.
3) Fixed defensive positioning error on right hand side of the field.

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Patch V1.08b
notes.content:
Hi Rugby Fans

Small update:
1) Unselected players now better run un to the passed ball. CPU teams used to pass the ball to the winger close to the touchline, then the receiving player wont go for the ball. That is fixed now
2)CPU try conversion kick bug, sometimes they will kick from the goalline.. not from infield. Fixed.
3) Cant control players now on your 22 and goal line dropouts.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.08a
notes.content:
Hi Retro Rugby Fans

notes.title: Patch V1.08
notes.content:
Hi Rugby Fans
V1.08 is live

New update to the game:

1) CPU team now runs with more conviction. Better evasion and hard lines from the opponents. 
2) Fixed the controller general play kick angle error in 2nd half(box kicks and penalties)
3) Fixed Animation error on CPU team on 2nd half
4) Passing now out the ruck to static/retreating players is now more accurate

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch V1.07 - Update
notes.content:
Hi Rugby Fans

Added advantage on knock on.
In case of a knock on, the ball will fall to the ground, advantage will be granted. IF same team that knocked the ball on, picks op the ball, advantage over. If opposing team picks up the ball, play on.

CPU team will now be more careful to run out of the field of play with ball in hand.

Enjoy

notes.title: Patch 1.06a - Minor Update
notes.content:

Small minor update
1) When CPU team has scrum, some of your players wont line up correctly. Fixed that
2) The CPU team did not correctly cover the pitch when chasing down their kicks. Fixed now. Less space to go around the defense on the carry back. 

Enjoy

notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Hi Guys

Thanks for the support of the game. The response has been amazing. 
Glad the feedback is positive.

Here is a [b]important update[/b] on the gameplay:

1) Fixed the AI(CPU) from stopping in contact. The CPU will now try to push through the tackle more realistically. Was a bug that needed some attention.
2) Fixed the low tackle miss rate on player controlled team side. Bug that only in some small percentage of cases worked correctly. Will now work as intended. 
3) Fixed the ball bounce indicator in the 2nd half.
4) Menu system improvements
5) Reworked the tackle mechanic. More stable.

Keep well
